comment: Launchable parts of the game. play.ps1 reads this; `play.ps1 -Install` regenerates the double-clickable shims in play/apps/. Every part runs through the component runner (--scene ...), which uses a THROWAWAY profile — none of these can touch the real save.

parts.name: title
parts.title: Title Card
parts.about: The painted title screen. Tap to quit.

parts.name: mantel
parts.title: The Mantel (hub)
parts.about: Quest board, loadout picker, Magpie Exchange, achievements.

parts.name: casebook
parts.title: The Casebook
parts.about: Deeds and Knowledge — the journal page.

parts.name: case-board
parts.title: The Case Board (empty)
parts.about: A fresh board: the question, one known suspect, five empty slots.

parts.name: prologue
parts.title: The Prologue (from the top)
parts.about: The whole opening, in case you want it — everything else skips it.

parts.name: battle-vole
parts.title: Fight: the Vole (tutorial)
parts.about: The teaching fight. Ordered deck, coached, unlosable by design.

parts.name: battle-wisp
parts.title: Fight: a Gutter-wisp
parts.about: The first real fight, on the dusk rooftops (sunbeams turn 2 and 4).

parts.name: battle-dog
parts.title: Fight: the Chained Dog
parts.about: Punishes careless play. Where banking and Concentrate start to matter.

parts.name: battle-wraith
parts.title: Fight: a Rag-wraith
parts.about: The three-answer puzzle: aggression dies here, defence wins.

parts.name: battle-coat
parts.title: Fight: the Empty Coat
parts.about: The quest elite, with the Swat kit the garden route unlocks.

parts.name: battle-stealth
parts.title: Fight: Alarm and stealth
parts.about: The Captain's Lawn: Ferocity costs more AND rings the Alarm. Pinned seed.

parts.name: battle-boss
parts.title: Fight: the Unpicked (boss)
parts.about: Meant to be survived, not beaten. For checking defeat and retreat.

parts.name: prowl-night-rounds
parts.title: Prowl: Night Rounds
parts.about: Three encounters, board card to payout. Unlocks Shelf Justice.

parts.name: prowl-garden
parts.title: Prowl: The Garden Route
parts.about: The stealth quest — sleeping houses, Ferocity raises the Alarm.

parts.name: prowl-coat
parts.title: Prowl: An Empty Coat
parts.about: The two-fight quest that ends on the elite.

parts.name: press-on
parts.title: Prowl: Press On economy
parts.about: Healthy kit through a 3-fight quest: both Press On offers, satchel maths.

parts.name: last-life
parts.title: Prowl: one hit from the Court
parts.about: 1 hp, thin pool, no charges. The fast route to death and the Toll.

parts.name: case-open
parts.title: Chapter 1: case in progress
parts.about: Two things found, threads strung, a knot owed, the Chandlers annoyed.

parts.name: spine-demo
parts.title: Chapter 1: spine systems
parts.about: Evidence/knot/standing grants, a flashback, a knot redeemed, a gated scene.

parts.name: recap
parts.title: Chapter 1: the recap card
parts.about: The cold-launch card alone. With no evidence it drops to the hub — as designed.

parts.name: dev-menu
parts.title: Developer Mode (jump anywhere)
parts.about: One list: every screen, story beat, fight, prowl, minigame and saved state.

parts.name: stitch
parts.title: Minigame: Seam & Stitch
parts.about: Sew one closed seam. Tap an edge to stitch, tap again to unpick.

parts.name: stitch-big
parts.title: Minigame: Seam & Stitch (4x4)
parts.about: The Wickhouse seam - the L4 ritual chart, full size.

parts.name: stitch-mirror
parts.title: Minigame: the mirrored seam
parts.about: Ch3 payoff: the clues read backward while the seam does not.

parts.name: testimony
parts.title: Minigame: Testimony
parts.about: Press the shift-boss, then present the thing that breaks her story.

parts.name: ward
parts.title: Minigame: Patch the Ward
parts.about: Quilt the tear shut. Every patch is paid from your actual paw.

parts.name: lattice
parts.title: Minigame: The Unpicking
parts.about: Pull only the threads with nothing lying over them.

parts.name: lattice-elastic
parts.title: Minigame: The Unpicking (elastic)
parts.about: The variant that re-crosses itself when you remove a thread.

parts.name: crossing
parts.title: Minigame: The Long Way Round
parts.about: Push-your-luck traversal on the same deck you fight with.

parts.name: fresh-start
parts.title: State: first boot
parts.about: Nothing owned but Scratch. What a brand-new player sees.

parts.name: post-prologue
parts.title: State: just finished the prologue
parts.about: The standard five-skill kit and the starter deck.

parts.name: worn
parts.title: State: worn mid-prowl
parts.about: Thin deck, 4 hp, spent charges — the state fresh-fight testing never sees.

parts.name: rich
parts.title: State: over-levelled
parts.about: Maxed tonics, rare cards, every skill. Stress the economy's top end.

parts.name: moonlight
parts.title: State: Moonlight-heavy deck
parts.about: A wild-heavy pool against the captain — payment-planner stress.

parts.name: coat-finale
parts.title: State: the Coat with the Swat kit
parts.about: Garden-route-first ordering, pinned seed.
